card.name: SS Broly, Full Power Frenzy
card.skill:
[triple strike]
[permanent] When this card would leave your Battle Area, you may place 5 Extras from under this card under your Leader instead.
[auto] When this card is played, place up to 7 Extras from under your Leader under this card, then choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards and KO it.
[activate: main][limit 1]{g}{g}, if there are 10 or more cards under your green cards: Play this card from your hand.

qa.q: What happens if you have 5 Extras under this card and its power becomes 0?
qa.a: This card is placed in its owner's Drop when its power becomes 0, so you can use this card's [Permanent] skill to move the 5 Extras from under this card under your Leader instead. But even if you do, you then place it in your Drop because its power is 0.

qa.q: This card leaves your Battle Area while it has 3 Extras under it, then you use this card's [Permanent] skill to place the 3 Extras from under this card under your Leader. Can you leave this card in your Battle Area?
qa.a: No, you can't. You must place 5 Extras from under this card under your Leader instead of allowing "would leave your Battle Area."
